header: This replaces the stored text of an ALREADY-UPLOADED circular, in place: its chunks (circular_chunks) and its whole-document vector (circulars.embedding). It NEVER touches its id, serial number, dates, headline, author or page images. Used by scripts/ocr-consensus.ts (the consensus correction of the stored text). Safety: applyReread() computes every embedding first (a failure there changes nothing), saves the old chunks and vectors to a backup file, then replaces them in ONE transaction; if anything fails nothing changes. restoreFromBackup() puts the old text and vectors back exactly. Everything outside the logic (the embedding service, the database) is injected, so I can test it without network access.

doc: Puts a circular's old chunks and whole-document vector back exactly as saved in a backup file.

behaviours: a plan is applied in one transaction (BEGIN ... COMMIT)
every chunk and the document were embedded
the backup holds the OLD text and vectors
the old chunks are deleted before the new ones are inserted
a plan that is not 'would-change' is refused
if the embedding service fails nothing is written
a database error halfway is rolled back
restore replaces the chunks and the document vector in one transaction
